title: Add E2E test for signup validation
body: Create a Playwright E2E test that verifies validation errors are displayed when submitting empty signup form. The test should: (1) Navigate to /signup, (2) Click Create Account without filling fields, (3) Verify error messages appear under each field. Currently no E2E test exists for this critical user flow.
rationale: This bug would have been caught by an automated test. E2E tests for auth flows are essential for catching validation regressions.

title: Investigate root cause of silent failure
body: The fix adds defensive error handling, but the actual root cause of why validation errors weren't showing is unclear. The validateSignupForm function appears correct. Possible causes: (1) React state update batching issues, (2) Translation function returning undefined in some cases, (3) CSS/styling hiding error messages. Further investigation needed if bug persists.
rationale: The defensive fix ensures errors are shown but doesn't explain the original behavior. Understanding the root cause would prevent similar bugs.
